correctness.rationale: For every strictly positive row, equality in the cube norm occurs precisely on a monochromatic triple face. The exact support formula yields the radius as 1 minus twice the maximum minimum two-sided edge mass. Every proper two-colouring is forced to have a monochromatic deleted line, and the remaining four signs are all opposite or one agrees; exact mass counting gives upper margins 1/5 and 1/6, with an explicit norm-one dual functional achieving 1/5. This proves 3/5 for all positive real row weights and full generation after line restoration. The standalone Fraction-only checker confirms 128 sign patterns, 10 exceptional colourings, 118 norming vertices, all 7 deletions and the exact support witness.

value.rationale: The Fano hypergraph is the canonical minimal 3-uniform failure of property B, and deleting any of its lines is the natural first loss of qualitative generating behaviour. The exact remaining radius 3/5 quantifies the sharp defect, uniformly across all positive incidence weights. The result identifies a motivated finite-dimensional Banach invariant not determined by the general r-generation framework or qualitative Fano edge-criticality, and supplies a reusable benchmark for studying quantitative generation under constraint deletion.
